structure:
Part 5 — 'Germinal Data Elements' — of Confluence page "Live Animals & Germinals Data Fields - V4", version 210 (read from workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/6497338582.json at .result.body, bytes 132,645–144,805 of the 162,599-byte storage-format HTML, dumped and pretty-printed into the part's working folder). The page carries no page-level status macro, so nothing here rests on an unapproved decision; the only status macros in this slice are the seven green GERMINALS markers in the Impacts column.

Layout of the slice, read in full: (a) the h2 heading 'Germinal Data Elements' (local-id 4d53f1e1ac36); (b) one intro paragraph (local-id 63ada240ab69) — the section applies to germinal products only, semen, embryos and ova, and a notification must be submitted with at least one germinal identifier per animal; (c) one full-width table (ac:local-id b48994db9c1f) with an 8-column colgroup and **no header row at all** (0 <th> cells) — its column meanings carry over from the earlier sections' tables: Field Name | Type | Conditions / Values | Applies at: | Source | Mandatory | Example | Impacts; (d) the closing note paragraph (local-id 8f38c497db66) de-scoping CPH and Permanent Address for germinals; then the slice stops, the next element being the h1 'Address Block' (part 6).

The table holds **7** data rows, not the 6 the partition's `read` lists. In page order: (1) 'Total gross weight (kg)' — a row the partition did not name, whose field-name cell is wrapped in an ac:inline-comment-marker (ac:ref 18a10c1e-5d7f-4b1c-a73b-e122e958c9a0), numeric with Max/Min/decimals, Notification level, Optional, example 24.50; (2) Quantity (unit/pieces) — Numeric, Max: 1,000, Commodity Level, the section's only 'Mandatory to proceed' row, example 10; (3) Temperature — enum (single-select), 'One of:' Ambient / Chilled / Frozen, Commodity Level, Optional, example Frozen; (4) Donor name/ID — string - max 58, Unit Level, Optional, example GB1238765; (5) Collection date — date, 'Must be a valid date in DD/MM/YYYY format.', Unit Level, Optional, example 12/12/2026; (6) Production date — same as Collection date; (7) Identification Number/Mark — string - max 58, Unit Level, Optional, example GB1238765. Source is 'User' on all seven rows, and Impacts is GERMINALS alone on all seven (no ANIMALS marker anywhere in the section).

Five 'Applicable to' expand macros are nested inside the Applies at cells of rows 3–7 (Temperature 49f93ad52d12, Donor name/ID 453901be09fc, Collection date 13439c1004ca, Production date e83005ecb355, Identification Number/Mark d5c823b26daf), each read in full. All five list the identical 12 germinal commodity entries, byte-for-byte the same paragraph, with the commodity codes' leading zero dropped (5111000, 5119985). Rows 1 and 2 (Total gross weight, Quantity) carry no expand. Four Conditions / Values cells are blank (rows 1, 2, 4, 7). Every claim below is from this slice only; nothing outside it is claimed.

claims.statement: The Germinal Data Elements table has no header row, so the meaning of its eight columns is not stated in the section and has to be carried over from the earlier data tables on the page.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f — an 8-column colgroup and a tbody whose first child is the 'Total gross weight (kg)' data row, with no th cells anywhere in the section
claims.note: Read against the earlier sections, the columns are Field Name | Type | Conditions / Values | Applies at: | Source | Mandatory | Example | Impacts, and the cell contents fit that order; but the section itself never labels them.

claims.statement: The section uses three 'Applies at' levels across its seven fields: Notification level for Total gross weight (kg), Commodity Level for Quantity (unit/pieces) and Temperature, and Unit Level for Donor name/ID, Collection date, Production date and Identification Number/Mark.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f, column 'Applies at:' across rows 1–7
claims.note: It follows from reading the Applies at cell of each of the seven rows. The section writes the labels as 'Notification level', 'Commodity Level' and 'Unit Level', which is not the 'Level 1 / Level 2 / Level 3' wording the page's Live Animal preamble uses for the same three levels.

claims.statement: Only one of the section's seven germinal fields is mandatory — Quantity (unit/pieces), 'Mandatory to proceed' — and the other six are Optional; no germinal field is marked mandatory to submit.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f, column Mandatory across rows 1–7
claims.note: It follows from reading the Mandatory cell of each of the seven rows: one 'Mandatory to proceed' and six 'Optional'. This sits against the intro's submit-time rule that at least one germinal identifier per animal is required (claim confluence-6497338582-p5-002), which no table row carries. Unlike the Reason of Import and Animal Identifiers sections, the Germinal table has no 'Field Block' banner row to carry a block-level mandatory rule.

claims.statement: Every field in the Germinal Data Elements section is sourced from the User; none is pre-filled from another system.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f, column Source across rows 1–7
claims.note: It follows from all seven Source cells reading 'User' (highlighted rgb(198,237,251)). No row cites gov.identity, MDM or a reference list.

claims.statement: Every field in the Germinal Data Elements section impacts the GERMINALS journey only; no row in the section carries an ANIMALS marker.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f, column Impacts across rows 1–7
claims.note: It follows from all seven Impacts cells holding a single green GERMINALS status macro and no other. Read with the page's preamble note that a field applying to only one journey is marked as such, these seven fields are germinal-only.

claims.statement: County Parish Holding (CPH) and Permanent Address are not required for germinal products: they apply to the animal journey only.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, closing note paragraph local-id 8f38c497db66, immediately after table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f
claims.quote: Not required for germinal products: County Parish Holding (CPH) and Permanent Address. These apply to the animal journey only.
claims.note: 'Not required for germinal products:' is bold in the source. This de-scopes both fields for the germinal set; their own specifications are in the Live Animal Data Elements table (part 1's slice), where each carries a commodity expand.

claims.statement: The section's closing note names only CPH and Permanent Address as not required for germinal products, and does not say which other live-animal fields the germinal journey drops or keeps.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, closing note paragraph local-id 8f38c497db66
claims.note: Per-field applicability for every other field has to be read from the Impacts markers in the other sections' tables, not from this section. The germinal set's full field list is therefore not stated in one place.

claims.statement: The two free-text germinal fields, Donor name/ID and Identification Number/Mark, are given a maximum length of 58 characters but no permitted character set, pattern or minimum length.
claims.ref: §Germinal Data Elements, table ac:local-id b48994db9c1f, rows 4 "Donor name/ID" and 7 "Identification Number/Mark", columns Type and 'Conditions / Values'
claims.note: Both rows' Conditions / Values cells are empty, so the only stated rule is the length. The shared example GB1238765 is not declared as a format.
